create_BenchmarkSuiteScheduler: create a BenchmarkSuiteScheduler instance to monitor training checkpoints and launch evaluations dynamically
run_BenchmarkSuiteScheduler_evaluate: run the BenchmarkSuiteScheduler evaluate method to continuously monitor training and launch evaluation jobs as checkpoints become available
save_BenchmarkSuiteScheduler_benchmarks: save evaluation benchmark results to JSON files in the training checkpoint evaluation directory
retry_BenchmarkSuiteScheduler_jobs: retry failed or terminal-state SLURM evaluation jobs with auto-retry and configurable max retries
get_BenchmarkSuiteScheduler_metrics: retrieve benchmark metrics from completed evaluation jobs and aggregate the largest metric values
